description: Commercial/office electricity consumption profile. Peak during business hours (08:00-18:00), low baseload overnight. Adapted from BDEW G0 standard commercial profile for Italian context.
notes: ~65% of daily consumption during sun hours (08:00-18:00)
Overnight baseload ~15% (security, HVAC standby, IT infrastructure)
Expected self-consumption rate: 45-65% for well-sized systems

monthly_weights_validation.source: Commercial pattern: more uniform than residential, slight winter increase from lighting/heating
